title: LinUCB for contextual bandits
brief: Fit a ridge regression per arm, score arms with a prediction plus a confidence width, update the inverse in O(d^2), and watch regret stay far below a context-blind arm's.
hints: linucb_terms: theta_hat = A_inv @ b, the mean is theta_hat @ x, and the width is np.sqrt(x @ A_inv @ x).
Sherman-Morrison: with u = A_inv @ x, the new inverse is A_inv - outer(u, u) / (1 + x @ u).
In run_linucb, update only the pulled arm: A_inv[arm] with sherman_morrison and b[arm] += reward * x.
